stationScope.evidence: RhönEnergie Fulda operates the DE*REF physical network. The official tariff page published 2026-05-28 confirms Gelegenheits-Lader from 0.51 EUR/kWh with no monthly fee and Viel-Lader from 0.45 EUR/kWh with a 5 EUR/month fee. Current tariff verification by ChargeSurfer on 2026-09-04 resolves the operator-owned-network connector split as 0.51/0.61 EUR/kWh AC/DC for Gelegenheits-Lader and 0.45/0.55 EUR/kWh AC/DC for Viel-Lader, covering RhönEnergie Fulda physical locations. No third-party roaming price is propagated.

adhocDeferred.reason: RhönEnergie confirms QR/app access when no RFID card is available, but current public sources do not expose a reproducible exact ad-hoc price per DE*REF EVSE. No ad-hoc price is inferred from contract or roaming tariffs.

roamingDeferred.reason: Third-party-network prices under RhönEnergie tariffs are eMSP roaming prices and are kept separate from the physical DE*REF CPO network.

note: Conservative partial integration. Energy prices are attached only to RhönEnergie Fulda's own DE*REF network under the two named RhönEnergie charging-card tariffs. Gelegenheits-Lader has no monthly fee; ChargeSurfer reports a one-time 9.90 EUR RFID card fee, which is not allocated into per-session charging cost here. Blocking/parking fees are omitted until their exact applicability on the own network is verified. Ad-hoc direct-payment pricing remains deferred.
